texts.en:
Our homeworld already has a small number of £building£ Buildings, but we should build another one.

To do this, select the homeworld in the Outliner and click on the Surface tab. Select an empty building slot in a district, and choose from one of the available buildings. Assuming we have enough Resources, construction will begin immediately.

Buildings provide £job£ Jobs, but nothing will be produced until £pops£ Pops are assigned to work there. You can check which jobs your Pops are performing in the Economy tab.
